findings.issue: Skill link path is not relative to the task file: `[skills/code-writing/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md)`. From `work/05-projects/tasks/3.md`, this resolves to `work/05-projects/tasks/.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` which does not exist. Tasks 1, 2, 4, 5 use the correct `../../../.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` prefix.
findings.fix: Change the link target to `../../../.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` so it resolves from the tasks directory to the project-root `.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md`.

findings.issue: Display text of the skill link starts with `.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` (an absolute-looking path) while other tasks (2, 4, 5) use `skills/code-writing/SKILL.md`. Cosmetic inconsistency only — the link target itself is correct.
findings.fix: For consistency with other tasks, change the display text to `skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` so all tasks use the same shape: `- /skill:code-writing — [skills/code-writing/SKILL.md](../../../.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md)`.

findings.issue: Reviewer report paths use absolute paths (`/Users/pavlokorolov/IdeaProjects/simple-sender/work/05-projects/logs/working/task-1/...`), while tasks 2-5 use repo-relative paths (`work/05-projects/logs/working/task-N/...`). Both work, but the absolute path is machine-specific and breaks portability.
findings.fix: Replace absolute paths with `work/05-projects/logs/working/task-1/code-reviewer-{round}.json` etc., matching tasks 2-5.

findings.issue: The `User` verification step is conditional on Task 9 having shipped (`If Task 9 has not run yet, the user verification is performed by mounting the component in isolation OR satisfied by the unit specs only`). This is noted in the task itself but means the `verify: [user]` frontmatter value may not be exercisable when the task runs. Acceptable given the wave ordering, but worth flagging.
findings.fix: Optional — either keep the conditional note (current state) or downgrade `verify` to `[]` for Task 5 since the unit tests already cover the contract; user verification of the dropdown becomes implicit through Task 9's smoke check after layout integration.
